card.name: Punctuation within local anesthetic lists
card.fires_on: Commas, opening parentheses and the word "to" right after a local anesthetic name (lidocaine, benzocaine, bupivacaine) or the heading "Local anesthetics". Seen in drug-interaction lists and contraindication text.

modes.label: Comma in anesthetic list
modes.description: Comma after one caine-type drug name in a list of local anesthetics.
modes.example: itrites nitroglycerin, nitroprusside, nitric oxide, nitrous oxide Local anesthetics articaine, benzocaine<<,>> bupivacaine, lidoc

modes.label: Hypersensitivity wording
modes.description: The word "to" after hypersensitive in contraindications of local anesthetic products.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS: Mepivacaine is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity<< to>> it or to any local anesthetic agent

modes.label: After brand name
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after a local anesthetic brand name.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word "local" (as in local anesthetic) coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the punctuation and small words in local anesthetic lists, where the next word is likely "local" or another anesthetic.
